leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply the useState hook to declare multiple independent state variables within a single component.
Implement TypeScript type annotations to define the data types for each state variable.
Utilize destructuring assignment to access state values and their corresponding setter functions.
Execute state updates for individual variables using their specific setter functions.
Construct event handlers that modify specific state variables based on user interactions.
Control component rendering by using multiple state values in conditional logic and JSX expressions.
Define separate initialization values for each state variable based on their intended purpose.
Access multiple state values simultaneously to compute derived values or perform validations.
Modify individual state variables independently without affecting other state values in the component.
Return JSX that displays and interacts with multiple state variables through event handlers.
